title: Agent chat P4: polish + e2e oracle (chat drives the stage) + docs
description:
Finalized agent chat pane (P4). DONE.

Asserts the shape appears in the live document (getDocument shape count +1) AND the stage_add_shape tool chip renders with no error. Proves: model tool-call -> buildAgentTools execute -> dispatchAgentCommand -> document mutation.
